# PromptInvoice

> Free invoice, quote, estimate, receipt and payment voucher generator. Agents can create a finished PDF with one
> HTTP request: POST https://invoice.flowsxr.com/api/pdf with the document as JSON, receive application/pdf.
> No account or key. Nothing is stored. Totals are calculated for you.

## For agents

- [Agent guide](https://invoice.flowsxr.com/agents): every field, document types, examples, errors, rules for agents working for a person
- [Machine-readable usage](https://invoice.flowsxr.com/api/pdf): GET returns the fields, limits and an example as JSON

## Minimal request

POST https://invoice.flowsxr.com/api/pdf
Content-Type: application/json

{"number": "INV-0042", "from": {"name": "Studio Nova Ltd"}, "to": {"name": "Acme Corp"},
 "items": [{"description": "Prototype development", "qty": 24, "rate": 120}], "currency": "NZD"}

Use "docType": "voucher" when the business is paying someone. Errors come back as 400 with a list of { field, message }.

## Optional
